transcript.text: The thing that will get you the biggest
pay increase is being someone worthy of
a higher pay increase. And so, this is
where a lot of people end up in hot
water. They insist on having all these
things on their first job, rather than
being willing to get the experience that
they can then leverage to get the far
bigger paying job in the future, because
then they can state the facts and tell
the truth that I really did this thing,
and I think if I did this thing for you,
you would make this much, and I'm just
asking for a percentage of that.

transcript_only_text:
The  thing  that  will  get  you  the  biggest 
 pay  increase  is  being  someone  worthy  of 
 a  higher  pay  increase.  And  so,  this  is 
 where  a  lot  of  people  end  up  in  hot 
 water.  They  insist  on  having  all  these 
 things  on  their  first  job,  rather  than 
 being  willing  to  get  the  experience  that 
 they  can  then  leverage  to  get  the  far 
 bigger  paying  job  in  the  future,  because 
 then  they  can  state  the  facts  and  tell 
 the  truth  that  I  really  did  this  thing, 
 and  I  think  if  I  did  this  thing  for  you, 
 you  would  make  this  much,  and  I'm  just 
 asking  for  a  percentage  of  that.
